summary: Iteration 3 retest of 4 iteration-2 UI fixes on /app/frontend/app/play.tsx. Source verification: all 4 fixes are present in the source code (confirm-abort modal lines 500-524, confirm-new modal lines 526-549, play-elo-change block lines 464-483, tick/bump-driven re-render wired via line 393 conditional). Live Playwright verification BLOCKED by TWO new critical bugs: (A) runtime ReferenceError `playSound is not defined` on every player move crashes the entire page with an Expo red screen, (B) clicking play-abort button does NOT open the confirm-abort modal despite the Pressable being tappable (verified via mouse.click, evaluate-dispatchClick, and Playwright locator click — three methods all failed to trigger the state update / Modal render).

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: playSound is not defined. Called at lines 116-118, 182-184, and 239 but NEVER imported or declared. On any player move (sq-e2 -> sq-e4) the onSquarePress handler throws and Expo shows the red-screen 'Uncaught Error: playSound is not defined' at app/play.tsx (184:16). Blocks every move and therefore prevents live verification of the Abort->New-game swap and all downstream flows.

Clicking the Abort Pressable does NOT open the confirm-abort modal. Tried: Playwright .click(force=True), page.mouse.click on the exact bounding-box center, JS-dispatched MouseEvent('click'), and dispatch_event('pointerdown')+('pointerup')+('click'). In all cases the DOM contains NO confirm-abort-yes / confirm-abort-no / [role=dialog] / [aria-modal=true] node — the Modal never flips visible. Comparable Pressable play-rule-info DOES open its Modal on click, so event plumbing works in general. Suspect onPress {() => setConfirmAbort(true)} is not firing for this specific button, or state update is being short-circuited.

Not live-verifiable because no move can be completed (see playSound bug). Source shows correct tick-driven conditional at line 393 (historySAN length > 0 renders play-new), and bump() is called in commitMove paths, but the crash on line 184 runs BEFORE bump() on line 188, so the re-render never happens. Fix the playSound bug first, then retest.

play-elo-change block is present in source (lines 464-483) with correct structure (before/after/colored delta). Not live-verifiable because no game can be completed until the playSound crash is fixed.

Source shows inline 'thinking...' text in PlayerStrip sub-label (line 353 `Bot · Level ${aiLevel} · thinking...`) and ActivityIndicator inline (line 664). thinkingOverlay style exists at line 785 but is NOT used anywhere (orphan style), so no full-screen overlay is rendered. Not live-verifiable because AI turn never starts (player move crashes first).

react_native_issues.issue: playSound helper missing — appears main agent added sound-effect calls without implementing/importing the function. Either add import (e.g. from expo-audio) or define `const playSound = (_k: string) => {};` as a no-op stub.

action_items: BLOCKER: Fix ReferenceError by declaring/importing `playSound` in play.tsx. Simplest stub: `const playSound = (_kind: 'check'|'capture'|'move'|'end') => {};` near top of component. Ideal: wire expo-audio correctly.

HIGH: Debug why ActionBtn onPress on play-abort is not firing or not flipping confirmAbort state. Suggestions: (a) add console.log inside the onPress arrow; (b) verify the Pressable isn't being shadowed by a sibling with absolute positioning; (c) try changing ActionBtn label=Abort onPress to a direct inline Pressable to isolate ActionBtn component bug; (d) confirm `const [confirmAbort, setConfirmAbort] = useState(false)` is declared and that nothing resets it to false in the same tick. Once fixed, retest the full confirm-abort-yes/no flow.

After the above two fixes, rerun Playwright covering: (1) play-abort -> confirm-abort modal, (2) move e2-e4 -> play-abort swaps to play-new, (3) play-new -> confirm-new modal, (4) OpponentStrip shows 'thinking...' inline with no large overlay during AI turn, (5) game-over path surfaces play-elo-change block.
critical_code_review_comments: playSound is referenced 5 times but never defined/imported — this is a clear regression introduced during iteration-2 fixes. TypeScript should have caught this; verify tsconfig strict/noImplicitAny settings or that the editor/lint step was actually run before commit.
thinkingOverlay style (line 785-790) is dead code — if intentional as guard against reintroduction, add a comment; otherwise remove.

Ref-based rendering on line 393 reads rcRef.current.historySAN().length on every render, relying on tick state for re-render. This works but is fragile — a dedicated `moveCount` state would be more idiomatic and self-documenting.

rca_of_issue: BUG-A (playSound): Grep of play.tsx shows 5 references to playSound but no `const playSound = ...` / no `import ... playSound`. The Chrome error explicitly reads `playSound is not defined` at app/play.tsx (184:16) in onSquarePress. Reproduction: navigate to /play, dismiss rule modal, tap sq-e2 then sq-e4. Fix: add a no-op stub or real expo-audio binding for playSound. BUG-B (abort modal): Clicking [data-testid=play-abort] via three different click pathways does not produce confirm-abort-yes/no in the DOM and no [role=dialog]/[aria-modal=true] is ever added. play-rule-info Pressable (same file, same component style) DOES open its Modal on click, so the RN Modal + Pressable combination works; something specific to the Abort ActionBtn's onPress or the confirmAbort state management is broken. Suggested next step: add `console.log('abort press')` inside the onPress and confirm whether the handler even runs.
